name: Shampoo
source:
Do you enjoy your life?
Aren’t there times when you’re pushing yourself too hard?
Aren’t you a little bit tired…?

In modern society, many people would like sooth their souls and get away from someone or something. But there are many men who hesitate to say such desires out loud, aren’t there? 

In “Shampoo”, there are no dramatic events or heart-racing suspense. Instead, this is a work that gives you a brief moment of relaxation. 

Many people have had the experience of having their hair washed by someone else. In that moment, aren’t you able to let it all go and feel at ease? This isn’t a story all about having your hair washed, but one that aims to give your heart that same gentle, healing feeling. 

When you’re tired, there’s a woman who will cradle you gently and give you her special smile… enjoy that healing moment.

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=42381]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
你享受现在的生活吗？
是否有些时候，你逼迫自己太过头了？
是不是已经有一点疲惫…？

现代社会中，许多人想要抚慰心灵，暂时远离某个人或某件事。然而，也有许多男性不敢坦率说出这样的愿望，对吧？

《Shampoo》没有戏剧性的事件，也没有令人心跳加速的悬念。相反，这是一部为你带来片刻放松的作品。

许多人都体验过由别人替自己洗头。那一刻，你是否能够放下一切，彻底安心？本作并不只是讲述洗头，而是希望为你的内心带来同样温柔而治愈的感受。

疲惫时，会有一名女性温柔地拥抱你，向你露出特别的微笑…请享受这段疗愈时光。

[简介翻译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=42381]Getchu.com[/url]]
